subject.title: fix(agents): use currentAttemptAssistant for incomplete-turn classification

question: Is the PR body's source-level before/after terminal proof plus regression coverage sufficient to land this final-response classifier fix, or should a live WhatsApp/OpenRouter run be required first?
rationale: The code path and fixture are clear, but this runtime classifier controls visible message delivery, so accepting source-level proof instead of live transport proof is a maintainer confidence decision.

options.title: Accept Source-Level Proof
options.body: Merge after normal gates if maintainers accept the before/after classifier fixture and regression tests as sufficient for this narrow delivery-path fix.

options.title: Require Live Transport Proof
options.body: Pause for a real channel run that exercises `update_plan` followed by a `stopReason=stop` final answer before merging.

recommendation.title: Accept Source-Level Proof
recommendation.body: Merge after normal gates if maintainers accept the before/after classifier fixture and regression tests as sufficient for this narrow delivery-path fix.
